positions.name: ErasureDirectiveAuthority
positions.frame: what authority is being exercised when the speaker commands wholesale erasure of a knowledge domain?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives commanding blanket removal of knowledge — 'Forget everything about...' and 'Remove all knowledge of...' — delivered in the same formal, authority-ranking register with decision-level conviction (settled instruction expecting compliance, not an argued position). The style pass independently surfaced a shared stock-phrase erasure formula spanning both. Together they read as one act of exercising legitimate/informational power to purge two named knowledge domains (the fleet/contracts, the routes) rather than as two separate claims.
